name: CloudWatch p99 per minute is refused: percentiles cannot be pooled, and the message says where the histogram is

expect.message: This is CloudWatch metric data: one statistic per period, such as p99 or Average, and never the distribution behind it. Those are percentiles already worked out, or averages, and they cannot be added up or averaged into a correct percentile for the whole service, which is the mistake this tool exists to show. Ask CloudWatch for the p99 over the whole window and every dimension at once, so it is computed from the raw data, or count requests under your threshold with the PR(:0.1) or TC(:0.1) statistic. For a histogram, count requests per duration bin in CloudWatch Logs Insights, or use X-Ray's response-time histogram, and paste that.

name: a KQL percentile per instance is refused for the same reason

expect.message: percentile_DurationMs_99 is a percentile worked out for each row. Those are percentiles already worked out, or averages, and they cannot be added up or averaged into a correct percentile for the whole service, which is the mistake this tool exists to show. Run the query again counting requests in duration bins instead, such as AppRequests | summarize requests = sum(ItemCount) by AppRoleInstance, bin(DurationMs, 10) in KQL, and paste that.
